name: Green space
summary: Parks, trees, forests and playgrounds around each school, from the OpenStreetMap map, worked out once and saved as a file.

el.name: Πράσινοι χώροι
el.summary: Πάρκα, δέντρα, δάση και παιδικές χαρές γύρω από κάθε σχολείο, από τον χάρτη OpenStreetMap, υπολογισμένα μία φορά και αποθηκευμένα σε αρχείο.

quality.uncertainty: Volunteers draw the map, so some parks and trees are missing or out of date.

notes: Plan: run a tool such as OSMnx once on a computer and save green-space share per 1 km cell as a static file. Check it against the satellite greenness of modis-ndvi: mapped parks should sit where NDVI is high; a gap points to unmapped gardens or a missing park.
